name: Spiced Honey Brew
desc: A specialty hot drink crafted by infusing hot honey-water with a selection of dried spices. Your chilled fingers feel an immediate wave of satisfaction just holding the glass. A single sip sends a gentle, aromatic wave of heat through you, perfectly steeling your body against the freezing gale.

value.text: Restores 26% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 570 HP every 5s for 30s.
